notes: Only n_o assigned. Original study/outcome matched; specific test unresolved. Experiment 1 and the aggressiveness outcome are identified, but the supplied description and p. 5 locator do not distinguish the semantic-priming main effect, processing main effect, interaction, or within-condition priming contrasts. The participant section gives 88 undergraduate students and six students declining participation, rather than an explicit critical-model analytic N. Table 1 supplies means/SDs but no final cell counts. No mutually exclusive final group counts are available to sum. Recruitment counts, nonparticipation, and test df are not treated as a verified analytic N. Printed candidate tests (not selected): F(1, 76) ⫽ 5.96, p ⫽ .017. ... F(2, 76) ⫽ 13.13, p ⬍ .0001. ... interaction, F(2, 76) ⫽ 21.57, p ⬍ .0001, ... t(25) ⫽ 2.79, p ⫽ .01. ... t(26) ⫽ 5.10, p ⬍ .0001. ... t(25) ⫽ 3.96, p ⬍ .001. The page-6 primed-only analysis also reports F(2, 41) = 36, p < .0001, with local-versus-control t(41) = 6.19, p < .0001 and global-versus-control t(41) = 2.04, p = .05. These involve a different subset from the full factorial model. No N derived from df or by subtracting nonparticipants from the stated participant total. No statistics entered into unassigned effect-size/p fields. PDF pages 4–6 visually checked; evidence quotes use canonical text.
